compositionIssues.detail: [composition/viewport-height] Preserve every node, relationship, and label. This 1084x3219 canvas (ratio 0.34) declares no intrinsic-height fit and is below the 1.55 wide ratio, so the desktop Reader can neither narrow it nor accept vertical scroll: it renders 3997px tall at the full 1346px width and the page reaches 4123px before cards against 900px, a certain visual-check failure. Either compact vertical spacing so meta.viewBox height is at most 699 at this width, or spread content sideways so the width is at least 4990 at this height; for architecture and readable-v2 workflow, omitting meta.viewBox lets the renderer size the canvas and declare the fit.
